one_line: Early Chalukya ruler who fortified Vatapi (Badami) and used grand Vedic rituals to announce his rising power in the Malaprabha valley.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, sturdy medium-tall build with a warrior’s broad shoulders and well-trained arms.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, thick dark brows, neatly trimmed small moustache, a faint vertical scar on the left cheek, default expression calm and assessing with a slight confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted at the center, pulled back into a smooth high knot (topknot) at the back of the crown, held by a simple gold band; short neatly combed sideburns, no loose strands over the forehead, no helmet in default look.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Deccan royal-warrior outfit: a long-sleeved, thigh-length reddish-brown cotton tunic with a round collar and subtle woven border pattern in dark maroon, worn over cream-colored, slightly tapered cotton trousers that gather neatly at the ankles; over the tunic a deep-ochre silk-bordered angavastra is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and wrapped around the waist like a sash, its edges showing a thin dark-green stripe; around his waist a broad leather-and-cloth war belt dyed dark brown with simple bronze fittings; on his torso, over the tunic, a fitted, plain bronze-colored lamellar-style chest guard that covers front and back but leaves the angavastra visible at the shoulder; forearms wrapped with dull bronze arm-guards strapped over the sleeves; feet in sturdy brown leather sandals with ankle straps; jewellery is modest—thin gold karnapasha earrings hugging the earlobes, a single short gold necklace with a small disc pendant, and a simple gold ring on the right index finger; a small ritual white tilaka line on the forehead.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved iron sword in a plain dark-brown scabbard with bronze chape, worn at his left hip, with a simple crossguard and a wrapped leather hilt, plus a round wooden shield with a dark lacquered surface and four small bronze bosses typically carried on his back or in his left hand.

ref_desc: Pulakeshin I is a medium-brown Deccan man in his late-30s with an oval face, small moustache, scarred left cheek, and black hair in a high knot, wearing a reddish-brown long tunic, cream trousers, deep-ochre angavastra, bronze chest guard and arm-guards, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a curved iron sword at his left hip with a dark shield.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pulakeshin I as a dignified early Chalukya ruler from sixth-century Vatapi: a medium-tall, sturdy man in his late-30s with a medium-brown Deccan complexion, oval face, strong jaw, straight nose, thick dark brows, a neatly trimmed small moustache, and a faint vertical scar on his left cheek; his thick black hair is parted in the center and pulled back into a smooth high knot at the back of the crown, held by a simple gold band, with short neat sideburns and no helmet. Dress him in a long-sleeved, thigh-length reddish-brown cotton tunic with a round collar and subtle darker maroon woven borders, over cream-colored tapered cotton trousers that gather at the ankles, and sturdy brown leather sandals. Over the tunic, show a fitted bronze-colored lamellar-style chest guard on front and back, with dull bronze arm-guards over his forearms, and a broad dark-brown leather-and-cloth war belt with simple bronze fittings around his waist. Drape a deep-ochre angavastra from his left shoulder across the chest and around the waist like a sash, its border edged with a thin dark-green stripe, clearly visible against the armor. Add modest jewellery: thin gold karnapasha earrings, one short gold necklace with a small disc pendant, and a simple gold ring on his right index finger, plus a small white tilaka line on his forehead. His signature gear is a long slightly curved iron sword in a plain dark-brown scabbard with bronze chape hanging at his left hip, with a simple crossguard and wrapped leather hilt, and a round dark-lacquered wooden shield with four small bronze bosses, shown either slung on his back or held at his side. Emphasize the reddish-brown, cream, deep ochre, dark green, and bronze color palette, and present him in neutral, front, side, and back poses to make his face, hair, clothing, armor, and weapons easy to redraw consistently.
